name: zzU2_wrap_step

tests.name: each rung agrees with itself -- two reads of the same hour
the sun's bearing turns the short way by small amounts, with no snap at any boundary

detail.note: the old curve froze the bearing through the night and turned 144 deg by the short arc in one frame at the wrap. A large value here means the running build predates the fix and everything below is measuring the old sun

tests.name: midnight is no more of a step than any ordinary quarter-hour

detail.note: zzT3 measured 0.0257 here against a median of 0.0014. A comparison rather than a threshold, because no one has grounds for an absolute number and the question is whether the boundary still stands out from its neighbours

tests.name: the night arc meets the day arc at 1900 without a tear

detail.note: a piecewise curve can tear where the pieces meet as well as where the clock wraps, and these two joins have never been looked at

tests.name: the night arc meets the day arc at 0500 without a tear

detail.note: a piecewise curve can tear where the pieces meet as well as where the clock wraps, and these two joins have never been looked at
